title: Kenworth K200 FUPS Bullbar with Road Train signs #48
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar, Disibio style channel with vents to cool oil cooler & spotlight mounts allow maximum clearance from back of light to cab. 76mm pipes std. option 88mm pipe. main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs.
